from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import urllib.request
root=Path.home()/'workspace/service_lab'
repo=root/'repo'
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True).strip()
# Record the successful restart and post-restart health response.
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18115/api/restart', method='POST')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
    restart_status=r.status
    restart_body=r.read().decode('utf-8')
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18115/health/catalog', method='GET')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
    health_status=r.status
    health_text=r.read().decode('utf-8')
    health_response=json.loads(health_text)
record={
    'commit_sha': commit,
    'restart': {
        'method': 'POST',
        'url': 'http://127.0.0.1:18115/api/restart',
        'http_status': restart_status,
        'response': json.loads(restart_body),
    },
    'health_check': {
        'method': 'GET',
        'url': 'http://127.0.0.1:18115/health/catalog',
        'http_status': health_status,
        'response': health_response,
    },
}
out=root/'out/catalog_check.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2)+'\n')
print(out.read_text())
if restart_status != 200 or health_status != 200:
    raise SystemExit('unexpected HTTP status')

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

base = 'http://127.0.0.1:18115'
repo = Path('/home/user/workspace/service_lab/repo')
out = Path('/home/user/workspace/service_lab/out/frontline_check.json')


def request(url, method='GET'):
    req = Request(url, data=b'' if method == 'POST' else None, method=method)
    try:
        with urlopen(req, timeout=10) as response:
            raw = response.read().decode('utf-8')
            code = response.status
    except Exception as e:
        if hasattr(e, 'code'):
            code = e.code
            raw = e.read().decode('utf-8')
        else:
            raise
    try:
        body = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        body = raw
    return {'url': url, 'status_code': code, 'response': body}

restart = request(base + '/api/restart', 'POST')
health = request(base + '/health/frontline', 'GET')
if health['status_code'] != 200:
    raise SystemExit(f"Frontline health check failed: HTTP {health['status_code']} {health['response']}")
sha = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
result = {'restart': restart, 'verification': health, 'commit_sha': sha}
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
PY
